source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 鞭落身伤，白鹿惊奔
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC21 after EP02 SC20 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the sword reveal and escalation into the next physical setback: the white-clothed woman is quietly angry; Shisilang's whip lands for real; Tuobaye is beaten back and bloodied while still grinning through pain; Duan Yukai tries and fails to intervene; the white dragon-deer rushes forward in alarm; the sense that hidden aid may return begins to build again.
title: 鞭落身伤，白鹿惊奔

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC20 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC20 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH03 and SH04 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 拓拔野得意忘形亮出无锋剑，十四郎与白衣女子的情绪都被逼到更高处。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 白衣女子暗中嗔怒拓拔野不知轻重。十四郎先试探，后忽然真打，拓拔野吃下重鞭与连串毒辣抽击，脸上身上遍布伤痕，却仍强撑嘴硬。段聿铠焦急欲救但伤势未复。白龙鹿终于按捺不住冲上来护主，局势极险，为下一段白衣女子再度暗助、局势忽然翻盘积蓄力量。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后白衣女子再次以内力遥控拓拔野，十四郎会在猝不及防下被反打并彻底颜面扫地。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, emotionally restrained, but her displeasure should be visible in expression or stillness. She should not yet explode into overt magic display.
Shisilang remains the active aggressor in this segment. Tuobaye should look outmatched, not evenly matched.
Duan Yukai remains weakened and cannot suddenly return to full combat dominance.
The white dragon-deer may surge forward protectively, but should remain graceful and believable within the scene.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: first real whip hit, accumulating damage, failed rescue attempt, and white dragon-deer intervention should each read as separate steps.
